_comment: Optional settings for LibreSessionFlow. Copy this file to ~/.claude/sessionflow.json (or point SESSIONFLOW_CONFIG at another path) and keep only the keys you want to change. Every key has a default that works with no setup. An environment variable, where one is listed, wins over this file. The file stays on your machine; never commit it.
_note_home: Where the plugins keep their own files: the handoff index, session summaries, maintain reports. Env: SESSIONFLOW_HOME.
_note_memory_dir: Where /absorb, /close, and /meet write durable memory. Empty means: the Claude Code auto memory folder of the current project when auto memory is on, otherwise <project root>/.claude/memory/. Env: SESSIONFLOW_MEMORY_DIR.

notify._note_command: Optional shell command that /close runs with the session summary on stdin. Empty means no notification: the summary is printed and nothing is sent. Env: SESSIONFLOW_NOTIFY_CMD.
notify._note_push_target: Alternative to command, for people who also run the LibreWhatsApp pack: a /push target such as "wa me". /close then drafts the summary through /push, which previews it and waits for your confirmation before sending.

share_prompt._note_transports: clipboard (default, no setup), gist (secret GitHub gist through gh), command (your shell command reads the formatted message on stdin), push (LibreWhatsApp /push, preview first).

meet._note_github_owner: GitHub user or org searched for prior work with a person. Empty means the account gh is logged in as.
meet._note_search_paths: Folders searched for earlier mentions of a person. The current project root is always searched.

pickup._note_search_paths: Folders searched for a project by name when /pickup gets a name instead of a path.
pickup._note_remotes: Optional. When the first word of /pickup matches a prefix here, the project is searched and read over ssh on that host.
pickup._note_chats: Optional. Chats that /pickup <project> all also reads, through LibreWhatsApp /pull, when that pack is installed.
